exposure: All original groups/outcomes are exposed. Original development only for learning; frozen old reserved mixtures for retrospective diagnostics. No fresh confirmation claimed.
target: Individual penetration force at mixing age30 minutes
task_revision: P100-055-AGING30-v1: source mixture metadata and mean initial-age force curve are declared calibration inputs. Not the original uncalibrated both-age task.
primary_metric: Equal-mixture mean absolute error; all assigned aged rows and both replicates
validation: Leave one complete development mixture out; tune ridge/clock scales using only inner whole-mixture folds. No random row splitting.
calibration: For every held mixture, its completed age0 force traces are available before the age30 test. Their replicate mean at matching native index is an input; no age30 target supplies calibration. No assumption of specimen pairing across ages.
initial_shape_change: Initial mean force at current native index minus its mean at indexmax(1,current_index-50). These are earlier age0 observations; divide by50 for an index slope if needed. No claimed seconds.
metrology: Force N; mixing age minutes. Penetration speed5um/s documented, sampling interval and penetration tip geometry unresolved; native1..600 is an index. Known formulation table per-m3 masses, SP/binder and VMA/binder ratios; do not silently use inconsistent intermediate a/b fields.
baseline_families: nested-group-tuned Gaussian kernel with identical inputs
scientific_tests: Finite structural buildup versus linear aging gain
Water-dependent multiplicative rebuild versus initial force alone
Initial-curve shape memory versus scalar calibration
Secondary squeeze-response ordering and ambiguous-label falsifier
Simplify retained pathways and compare calibration limits
selection: Simplest within1% of best scientific grouped development MAE, but keep the stronger tuned numerical/domain control as prediction reference if scientific candidates do not beat it. Freeze models and stopping before exposed diagnostics.
secondary_tests: Raw squeeze force at independently specified compressive strain0.10 and0.20, using specimen heights explicitly encoded in author formulas. Ordering comparison only within same source campaign, not independent replication. Exclude both duplicate1.0_0.30 blocks from cross-mixture mapping until author evidence resolves labels.
stopping: At least5 material scientific tests (repairs/controls labeled separately). Then stop after2 substantive tests fail to improve predictive or supported interpretive evidence; retain the failures.
admission: Retrospective predictive candidate only unless fresh independent groups confirm. No identified yieldstress, thixotropic rate, causal additive law or demonstrated industrial impact without extra measurements.
